Create one 1536x1024 landscape image of Lantaarnwoud, a safe region: a beautiful lush overgrown abandoned ecological city beside a turquoise lagoon at warm evening. Fixed elevated three-quarter isometric game camera, a readable explorable level environment with believable hand-painted 3D volume. Premium original fantasy action RPG art in the visual spirit of Torchlight 2 and Nine Parchments: rich painted natural materials, dramatic warm highlights and cool shadows, beautiful atmospheric depth, no outlines and no pixel art.

Keep paving bright and clear with minimal clutter; architecture and dense plants stay beside the traversable network instead of blocking it.

Do not create deep channels that divide the scene or dead-end major pathways. The image is the painted environment itself, with no game interface.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production creature animation sprite atlas for a painted 2.5D Canvas action RPG.
Create ONE 1536x1536 square PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly sixteen whole-body creature sprites arranged in an invisible regular 4-COLUMN BY 4-ROW atlas. Equal 384x384 cells with generous clear transparent gutters on EVERY side. Put each sprite fully inside the central 75 percent of its cell: no appendage, glow, feather, antler or effect may touch or cross a cell boundary. No visible grid, separators, floor, background, labels or decoration outside the sprites.
Fixed elevated three-quarter isometric camera, every creature facing down-right. Preserve each row's creature identity, anatomy, proportions, body scale, colors, materials, camera and foot-plane baseline in ALL FOUR poses. Whole bodies, naturally grounded feet, same relative ground plane in each cell. Original premium nonpixel detailed hand-painted fantasy action RPG art in the visual spirit of Torchlight 2 and Nine Parchments: convincing living sculpted 3D volume, richly painted material texture, dramatic warm highlights and cool shadows, beautifully readable silhouettes at 80 pixels, no drawn outlines.
ROW 1: a moss-and-crystal shellback turtle with a heavy organic shell, moss tufts, clear crystal growths and four broad strong legs. Same turtle and shell in every pose.
ROW 2: an elegant red-and-amber sun newt, clearly living amphibian with four legs and one graceful tail, glowing furnace throat, textured organic skin, no armor machinery.
ROW 3: a graceful mint-and-ivory wind owl creature with an expressive living owl face, two feathered sweeping wings, two sturdy bird feet, lush layered painted feathers.
ROW 4: an imposing antlered forest-bear boss, massive organic forelimbs, amber and golden fur, moss on its back, luminous branching antlers and a richly expressive living face. Its entire body and antlers fit comfortably inside every cell. Same impressive boss size across its four poses.
COLUMN 1: idle neutral pose.
COLUMN 2: walk pose, with clearly offset moving legs; the owl steps with slightly shifted wings.
COLUMN 3: expressive windup: turtle crouches and braces all legs, newt arches and expands its glowing furnace throat, owl draws both wings inward in preparation, bear raises one massive front paw in preparation.
COLUMN 4: attack release: turtle performs a grounded shell/body slam with a compact restrained impact shimmer, newt spits a SHORT compact fire burst down-right, owl extends both wings and directs a compact forward gust down-right, bear delivers a powerful front-paw ground slam with a small restrained amber impact. Keep ALL attack effects entirely within generous cell gutters.
Use actual alpha transparency, no painted checkerboard. All sixteen isolated sprites must be complete and equally registered. No extra creatures, extra limbs, robots, drones, skeletons, weapons, text, numbers, labels, sheet grid lines, visible borders, opaque shadows, scenery or solid backdrop.

inspection_notes: All requested creature species and four pose columns are present.

A few atlas subjects or effects cross nominal cell boundaries, so source rectangle measurement or normalization is needed for uniform slicing.
Lantaarnwoud includes low bridge parapets despite the request for bridges without rails.
The two arena backgrounds have open fighting floors and the requested two and three major cover islands respectively.
production: Original alpha retained; resized WEBP, connected-component source rectangle measurements and ground anchors only.
